rationale: CR-001 resolved: the tools guard now runs when the model is empty (source at HEAD confirmed, regression test added). Only CR-001 was in the fix set; CR-002 and CR-003 were outside it (waived), CR-004 is advisory and not in the fix set.

findings.title: Tools guard skipped when model is empty
findings.problem: The guard runs after `if (!model) return;`. A /v1/messages JSON body with no `model` and no configured model is never guarded, though the spec scopes the guard to all /v1/messages JSON bodies.
findings.impact: Narrow trigger: such a body is unusual (Claude Code always sends model, and config.model is normally set), but the spec requirement is only partially met and the placeholder is silently not applied.
findings.recommendation: Run the isMessagesPath tool-guard step before the empty-model early return, or restructure so the model-dependent normalizations return early without skipping the guard.
findings.check_notes: Early return removed; model-dependent normalizations wrapped in if (model); tools guard runs unconditionally for messages paths. Test added.

fix.change: Normalizer runs the tools guard even when no model is resolved; model-dependent normalizations are wrapped in if (model) instead of early return
fix.test: claude-request-normalizer.tools-guard.test.ts: still guards a /v1/messages body when no model is requested or configured

findings.title: No captured /compact body or 13808 outcome
findings.problem: AC1 and the spec exit condition require a real /compact body capture (via the shape-summary log) and the EPMCDME-13808 outcome before the guard ships; neither is attached. The spec says AC2 to AC7 are not closed without it. AC5 (401 retry seeing the rewritten body) is also not covered by a test.
findings.impact: Without capture evidence it is unconfirmed that tools are actually missing and that the gateway fix does not already cover it; a human must decide whether to ship the mitigation anyway or attach evidence first.
findings.recommendation: Attach the captured shape-summary and 13808 outcome to the task record, or record an explicit decision to ship without it (and optionally add a test that the 401 retry sends the rewritten body).

disposition.rationale: shipped as temporary mitigation; real /compact capture and 13808 outcome tracked in handoff

findings.title: Commit subjects embed ticket key
findings.problem: Commit subjects 'feat(proxy): EPMCDME-16965 add placeholder tools guard helper' and 'fix(proxy): EPMCDME-16965 add placeholder tools to Claude requests with tool history' carry the ticket key, which git-workflow.md Anti-Patterns says to put in the body footer instead.
findings.impact: Documented commit-format convention is not met in the review range; blocks the workflow standard.
findings.recommendation: Reword subjects without the ticket key and reference the ticket in the body footer (or let the squash PR title carry the format).

disposition.rationale: repo convention puts the ticket key in the commit subject (e.g. recent EPMCDME-16608 and EPMCDME-15557 commits); rewriting local history not warranted

findings.title: Non-array tools value overwritten by placeholder
findings.problem: summarizeToolShape treats a non-array `tools` (object or string) as zero tools, so with tool history the malformed value is replaced by the placeholder instead of passing through.
findings.impact: Trigger needs a malformed client request; upstream would reject it anyway, so the only effect is masking a client error.
findings.recommendation: Return false from ensureToolsForToolHistory when body.tools is defined and not an array.
